legal.privacyMetaDescription: WeCircle உங்கள் தகவலை எவ்வாறு சேகரிக்கிறது, பயன்படுத்துகிறது மற்றும் பாதுகாக்கிறது.

privacy.intro: WeCircle-க்கு வரவேற்கிறோம். உங்கள் குழுவின் தனியுரிமை மற்றும் தரவுப் பாதுகாப்பு எங்கள் முன்னுரிமை.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.lead: We only collect information that is necessary to provide and improve our service:

items.body: When you sign in using "Sign in with Apple," we collect the name and email address provided by Apple to create your secure account.
To enable group collaboration, we store the tasks, events, and group structures you create.

If you create "Virtual Profiles" for group members who do not have their own accounts (such as young children or elders), you confirm that you have the right to provide their basic identifying information (like names or nicknames) for group management purposes.
We may collect non-personally identifiable information such as device type, app crash logs, and usage metrics to ensure the stability of the App.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.lead: We use your data strictly to deliver the WeCircle experience:

items.body: To sync tasks, events, and group roles across your devices in real-time.
To provide customer support and respond to your feedback.

sections.heading: 3. Data Storage & Security
paragraphs: We utilize enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure (including Supabase) to store your data securely. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We employ strict Row-Level Security (RLS) database policies to ensure that your group data is completely isolated and only accessible to authorized members of your specific group.

sections.heading: 4. Information Sharing
paragraphs: We do not, and will never, sell your personal data to third parties. We only share information with trusted service providers (such as secure cloud hosting) strictly for the purpose of operating our service. We may also disclose information if required by law.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights and Data Deletion
paragraphs: You have full control over your data. You can edit your profile, delete specific tasks, or remove group members at any time within the App. You may also permanently delete your entire account and all associated data via the "Danger Zone" in the App's settings. Once deleted, this action is irreversible.

terms.intro: இந்த சேவை விதிமுறைகள் WeCircle வலைத்தளம் மற்றும் மொபைல் பயன்பாட்டின் உங்கள் அணுகலை நிர்வகிக்கின்றன.

sections.heading: 1. Description of Service
paragraphs: WeCircle is a group collaboration and productivity tool designed to help groups manage tasks, schedules, and member profiles. The service is provided "as is" and we reserve the right to modify, update, or discontinue features at our discretion.

items.body: You must provide accurate information when creating an account (e.g., via Apple ID).
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and any devices you use to access WeCircle.
You must promptly notify us of any unauthorized use of your account.
When you create a "Group" within the App, you act as the Administrator.
You are solely responsible for the data you input regarding other group members, including virtual profiles created for individuals without active accounts.
You are responsible for managing who is invited to join your group and for removing members when necessary.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.lead: You agree not to use WeCircle to:

items.body: Upload, post, or transmit any content that is illegal, abusive, harassing, or violates the privacy of others.
Attempt to hack, disrupt, or compromise the security of the App, our servers, or our database structure.
Reproduce, duplicate, copy, or resell any part of the Service without our express written permission.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, WeCircle and its creators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or revenues, whether incurred directly or indirectly, resulting from (a) your access to or use of or inability to access or use the Service; (b) any conduct or content of any third party on the Service.

sections.heading: 6. Governing Law
paragraphs: These Terms shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to Terms
paragraphs: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will notify users of any significant changes by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. Your continued use of the Service after such changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
